title: Incident Severity Trend by Classroom
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daycare:incident severity_score=* classroom=*
| timechart span=1mon avg(severity_score) as avg_severity, count as incidents by classroom
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends monthly average incident severity and count by daycare classroom.
value: A rising severity trend in one room is worth a conversation even when total incident counts look flat.
implementation: Include `severity_score` and `classroom` on every incident export and review monthly classroom trends.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of average severity by classroom.
grandmaExplanation: It counts whether any classroom is seeing rougher incidents over time.
